headline: Executive order aimed at increasing how much the federal government buys goods, products, and materials made in the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to make greater use of American-made goods, products, and materials. This likely involves the rules federal agencies follow when they buy things. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would be expected to favor American-made goods, products, and materials when making purchases.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that sell to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: Their products may be judged on how much of them is made in the United States.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 15, 2019; specific effective dates are not stated in the available material.
